work.summary: Bounded maintenance from real field use: prevent malformed sales-period OCR data from reaching Analytics draft creation, and make manual OCR identity corrections—especially vendor number—apply visibly and re-run machine matching before save.
implemented: Compact OCR review now validates sales previousClearAt, occurredAt, and elapsedHours before enabling draft creation.
Sales previousClearAt is directly editable in the compact review; other OCR identity fields including vendor number remain directly editable even when OCR returned a non-empty but wrong value.
Correcting vendor number or maker re-runs the existing machine-candidate lookup and refreshes the review.
The full editor now exposes an explicit '編集内容を反映して閉じる' path that re-matches and re-renders the compact review.
Draft creation performs a final fresh machine match plus blocking-issue recomputation before writing to IndexedDB.
Machine candidates are never auto-linked after a correction; the existing explicit user linkage action remains authoritative.

Added a browser regression gate covering invalid previousClearAt blocking/correction, vendor-number correction/rematch, full-editor apply, stale-save guard, actual IndexedDB draft creation, and 320px app-layout overflow.
